thread:
maria: Quick check — PR #412 proposes renaming the request param `pin_model` -> `model_pin` to match our internal naming. Is that a breaking change for SDKs or should we add a compatibility shim? Also tagging for code review.
ajay: If we change the param name without aliasing, older SDKs will 400. Recommend a one-release shim that accepts `model_pin` and maps to `pin_model` server-side, plus emit a deprecation header.
sam: +1 for shim. While we're here, can we add lightweight Accept-style negotiation (e.g. `Accept-Model: v2`) so future renames are less painful?
kate: Docs reminder: if we add a shim, we should emit an analytics event `deprecated_param_used` so we can measure how many clients still send the old name.
ben: What's the deprecation timeline you'd be comfortable with? SDK teams need time to update. Is this an isolated param rename or part of a contract version bump?
maria: It's isolated — we want to tidy names before a bigger model rollout. Proposed plan: 1) Add shim + telemetry 2) Return `Sunset` header on responses that used the old param (and `X-Deprecation-Warning`) 3) 30-day deprecation window then remove the alias. Thoughts?
ajay: Sounds reasonable. I'll add unit tests in platform-api for the alias parsing and an e2e to ensure routing + KV cache works with either param. I'll also add a CI check that warns if `deprecated_param_used` metric decreases unexpectedly. Linking SDK PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/198 — SDKs can accept both for a release.
deploy-bot: platform-api/test: passed on branch rename-param-shim (CI  ✔ )
sam: For testing, here's a minimal curl example to exercise the shim:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_pin":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}'
```
Expect 200 plus header `X-Deprecation-Warning: pin_model deprecated, use model_pin` and `Sunset: 2026-04-15`.
kate: I'll update OpenAPI (spec /v1/generate) to document both names with `deprecated: true` on the old field and add a changelog entry. Can we also surface a console banner on the route page for owners?
ben: I'll draft customer & partner comms and coordinate with Support. Also will add an alert rule to watch for an increase in 400s on /v1/generate after deploy (signal we broke older clients).
maria: Action items: @ajay add shim + tests + include `Sunset` header; @sam add acceptance example + test; @kate update OpenAPI + console banner; @ben draft comms & alerts. I'll merge the PR after green e2e and once SDK owners ack. Please react here when you pick up. :thumbsup:
ajay: Picking up tests now.
sam: I'll add the example and an acceptance test this afternoon.
kate: Taking OpenAPI + console banner work.
ben: Drafting comms, target sunset date: 2026-04-15 (30 days).
maria: Thanks all — I'll leave a note in PR to include release notes and link to the SDK PRs.
